unresolvedConflicts.subject: Manager manifest scope
unresolvedConflicts.issue: Official sources establish PSP Investments (Public Sector Pension Investment Board) as an active global infrastructure investor with direct investments, but the supplied repository snapshot records canonicalManager:null and knownManager:false, preventing inclusion of any vehicles under the contract.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Add or correct PSP Investments in the governed fund-manager universe outside this task, then rerun the census to allow fund or program inclusion under the canonical manager.

notes: Research intentionally stopped at manager-scope validation per contract because knownManager=false.
Official PSP materials confirm existence of a direct infrastructure investment program, but no fund or program rows can be returned under current manifest constraints.
The supplied manager universe lists PSP Investments, but the repository snapshot simultaneously flags it as unknown; the repository snapshot scope control was followed.
